## Resumo
A clean, modern LIGHT contact page for a forms-tool brand (AtlasForms), built around one signature pairing: a large cartographic 'Where to find us' MAP panel sitting beside a compact DARK form rail. The page stacks as a sticky blurred light nav, a full-bleed intro band (a teal 'Contact' eyebrow pill, a 'Talk to a human, or find us on the map.' display headline and a reassuring lead line), then THE CONTACT card: a single rounded-2xl bordered white card split lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr] into a LEFT map/location panel (a faux-cartographic .map-grid canvas of soft teal land blobs + rounded white 'roads', a 'Where to find us' label pill, a teal map PIN with a white callout card showing Lisbon HQ + email + phone, and a 2/4-up city strip Lisbon / Austin / Amsterdam / Singapore with a teal active underline) and a RIGHT dark ink-950 FORM RAIL (a 'Connect' header row with three rounded social icon tiles, a 'Get in contact' form of Email / Subject / Message dark inset fields with leading icons and a teal 'Send message' button, an 'We reply within one business day' reassurance line, and an 'Office hours' block with Mon-Fri / Sat-Sun rows plus a contact card of email / phone / address). A light full-bleed footer closes it. The reusable signature is the MAP-BESIDE-DARK-FORM contact system: a calm paper/ink/teal palette, an asymmetric map-panel-beside-dark-rail card, a CSS-only cartographic map texture, and dark inset fields with a teal focus ring. Inter throughout, Lucide icons, mood calm/trustworthy/local/human.

## Estilo Visual
Design a calm, modern LIGHT contact page for a forms-tool brand on a cool paper canvas (#f8fafc) with a deep slate ink text ramp and ONE accent: teal (#0f766e primary, with #0d9488 / #14b8a6 / #115e59 steps and #f0fdfa / #ccfbf1 tints). Register a Tailwind theme of paper #f8fafc; teal { 700 #0f766e, 800 #115e59, 600 #0d9488, 500 #14b8a6, 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1 }; ink { 950 #0b1220, 900 #0f172a, 800 #1e293b, 700 #334155, 600 #475569, 500 #64748b, 400 #94a3b8, 300 #cbd5e1, 200 #e2e8f0, 100 #f1f5f9 }; and three box-shadows shadow-card / shadow-pop / shadow-rail (see special_notes for exact values). Use Inter only (weights 400-900) and Lucide (iconify) icons. The whole point is the SIGNATURE PAIRING: a large cartographic 'Where to find us' map panel beside a compact dark form rail, inside one rounded-2xl bordered white card split lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr]. Build the map with CSS ONLY, no real map tiles: a .map-grid (background-color #e6f1ef + four layered linear-gradient grid lines, two fine rgba(15,118,110,.06) at 28px and two heavier rgba(15,118,110,.10) at 140px) overlaid with absolutely-positioned organic .blob teal land masses and rounded white .road / .road-soft strips rotated a few degrees, plus a floating teal PIN (a white ring-1 circle on shadow-pop holding a small teal dot ring-4 teal-100) wired to a white callout card (Lisbon HQ + a mailto + a phone), a 'Where to find us' label pill, and a 2/4-up city strip with a teal active underline. Style the form rail dark (ink-950) with dark inset .field controls (1px white/10 border, white/[.04] fill, placeholder ink-400) that on :focus turn the border teal-500, deepen the fill to ink-950 and add a teal ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(20,184,166,.18)); make the submit a teal-700 button with a shadow-rail glow that lifts on hover. Spend the single teal accent consistently: the eyebrow pill, the logo tile, the map land/roads/pin, the active city underline, the form focus ring, the primary button and the inline contact-card icons. Set eyebrows/labels uppercase with a .tracky .14em letter-spacing; make the headline font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.05] at text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl; nav links get an animated teal underline on hover. Use rounded-lg on fields/buttons, rounded-xl on the callout + inline card, rounded-2xl on the main card, rounded-full on pills. Mood: calm, trustworthy, modern, local and human, never a cold generic SaaS form.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky blurred light nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 header with a border-b border-ink-200/80 bottom hairline and a translucent blurred paper fill (bg-paper/85 backdrop-blur-md). Inner row mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6 (lg:px-8). LEFT: a logo link (flex items-center gap-2.5) = a grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-teal-700 text-white shadow-card tile holding a Lucide 'lucide:map-pinned' glyph (text-[20px]), beside a text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark reading 'Atlas' in text-ink-900 + 'Forms' in text-teal-700. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex, gap-8): four nav links 'Product' / 'Templates' / 'Pricing' / 'Contact' in text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-600, each a .nav-link with an animated teal underline that grows from width 0 to 100% on hover (the current 'Contact' link set text-ink-900). RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Sign in' text link (hidden below sm, text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900) and a 'Get started' primary button (inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-ink-900 px-4 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white shadow-card hover:bg-ink-800) with a trailing 'lucide:arrow-right' glyph (text-[15px]).

### Intro band
A full-bleed <section> with a border-b border-ink-200/70 bottom hairline on bg-paper. Inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-14 (lg:px-8 lg:py-20), holding a max-w-2xl block: first an EYEBROW PILL (inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-teal-700/20 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold .tracky uppercase text-teal-700) reading 'Contact', led by a Lucide 'lucide:message-square-dot' glyph (text-[14px]). Then a DISPLAY HEADLINE h1 (mt-5 text-4xl font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-ink-900 sm:text-5xl) reading 'Talk to a human,' + a hidden-on-mobile <br class='hidden sm:block'> + ' or find us on the map.' Then a mt-5 max-w-xl text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600 LEAD line: 'Send a note and a real person replies, usually within a few hours. Prefer to stop by? Pick an office below and we'll point you to the door.'

### Contact card shell + split
A <section id='contact'> on bg-paper. Inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-20 (lg:px-8) holding THE CARD: a grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white shadow-card lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr] container. The LEFT cell is a relative flex flex-col border-b border-ink-200 lg:border-b-0 lg:border-r (so below lg the divider is a bottom border, at lg it becomes a right border). The RIGHT cell is the dark form rail. The card clips its corners (overflow-hidden) so the map canvas and dark rail meet flush at the rounded edge.

### Left panel: CSS cartographic map canvas + pin + callout + label
Inside the LEFT cell, the MAP CANVAS = a .map-grid relative h-[360px] overflow-hidden (sm:h-[440px] lg:h-auto lg:min-h-[560px] lg:flex-1) block. The .map-grid CSS = background-color #e6f1ef with four layered linear-gradient grid lines (two fine rgba(15,118,110,.06) 1px lines at background-size 28px 28px, two heavier rgba(15,118,110,.10) 1px lines at 140px 140px). Over it, layer three absolutely-positioned organic .blob LAND MASSES (border-radius 42% 58% 55% 45% / 48% 50% 50% 52%, teal at .07-.10 alpha) at varying left/top/width/height, and five rounded white .road / .road-soft strips (.road = bg #fff opacity .9, .road-soft = rgba(255,255,255,.55), both border-radius 999px) positioned and rotated a few degrees to read as streets. Top-left, a LABEL PILL (absolute left-6 top-5 sm:left-7 sm:top-6, inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white/90 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold .tracky uppercase text-teal-800 shadow-card ring-1 ring-ink-200) reading 'Where to find us' led by a teal 'lucide:locate-fixed' glyph. Near center-left (absolute left-[38%] top-1/2 -translate-x/-y-1/2), a PIN + CALLOUT: the PIN is a grid h-12 w-12 place-items-center rounded-full bg-white shadow-pop ring-1 ring-ink-200 circle holding a small grid h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-teal-700 ring-4 ring-teal-100 dot; to its right (ml-3) a w-[244px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-white shadow-pop ring-1 ring-ink-200 CALLOUT CARD with a little -left-1.5 rotate-45 ring-1 arrow nub, a header row (border-b border-ink-100 px-4 py-3) with a text-[14px] font-bold text-ink-900 'Lisbon HQ' title, a mailto:hello@atlasforms.app row (border-b border-ink-100 px-4 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-50, a 'lucide:mail' glyph + the address), and a phone row (px-4 py-2.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-700, a muted 'lucide:phone' glyph + '+351 21 880 04 12').

### Left panel: city strip
Below the map canvas, a CITY STRIP = a grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-ink-200 border-t border-ink-200 sm:grid-cols-4 row of four cities, each a flex flex-col items-center gap-1 px-3 py-4 cell with a text-[14px] font-bold city name + a text-[11px] font-medium country. The FIRST city is ACTIVE: text-ink-900 with an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-0.5 bg-teal-700 top underline and a text-teal-700 country ('Lisbon' / 'Portugal'); the rest are text-ink-700 names with text-ink-600 countries ('Austin' / 'United States', 'Amsterdam' / 'Netherlands', 'Singapore' / 'Singapore'). Below sm the strip collapses from 4-up to 2-up.

### Right rail: connect header + dark form
The RIGHT cell = a flex flex-col bg-ink-950 p-7 text-ink-100 (sm:p-9) DARK FORM RAIL. Top: a CONNECT header row (flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-5) with a text-[12px] font-bold .tracky uppercase text-ink-400 'Connect' label and three SOCIAL TILES (each a grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-white/5 text-ink-300 hover:bg-teal-700 hover:text-white holding a Lucide glyph: 'lucide:twitter', 'lucide:github', 'lucide:linkedin'). Then a <form class='mt-6 flex flex-1 flex-col'>: a text-[13px] font-bold .tracky uppercase text-white 'Get in contact' heading + a mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-400 subline 'Drop the details and we'll route you to the right person.', then a mt-5 space-y-3 FIELD STACK of three groups, each a text-[12px] font-semibold text-ink-300 label over a control: Email (a relative wrap with a leading 'lucide:mail' icon absolute left-3 text-ink-500 + a .field w-full rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-white/[.04] py-2.5 pl-10 pr-3 text-[14px] text-white input type=email placeholder 'you@company.com'), Subject (same pattern, a 'lucide:tag' icon, placeholder 'What's this about?'), and Message (a .field textarea rows=4 resize-none rounded-lg border-white/10 bg-white/[.04] px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[14px] leading-relaxed placeholder 'Tell us a little more...'). Then the SUBMIT BUTTON: a .submit-btn mt-5 inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-teal-700 py-3 text-[14px] font-bold text-white shadow-rail with a leading 'lucide:send-horizontal' glyph reading 'Send message' (hover lifts translateY(-1px) + a teal glow). Below it a mt-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] text-ink-400 REASSURANCE line with a teal-500 'lucide:shield-check' glyph: 'We reply within one business day.'

### Right rail: office hours + inline contact card
Below the form, an OFFICE HOURS block (mt-7 border-t border-white/10 pt-5): a text-[12px] font-bold .tracky uppercase text-ink-400 'Office hours' label, then a mt-3 space-y-2.5 of two rows, each flex items-center justify-between text-[13px]: 'Mon - Fri' (a teal-500 'lucide:clock' glyph + text-ink-300 label) with a font-semibold text-white '9:00 - 18:00 WET' value, and 'Sat - Sun' (an ink-500 'lucide:moon' glyph) with a font-medium text-ink-400 'Closed' value. Then an INLINE CONTACT CARD (mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[.04] p-4 ring-1 ring-white/10): a mailto:hello@atlasforms.app row (text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-200 hover:text-teal-400, a teal-500 'lucide:mail' glyph + the address), a tel row (same, a teal-500 'lucide:phone' glyph + '+351 21 880 04 12'), and an ADDRESS row (flex items-start gap-2.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-300, a teal-500 'lucide:map-pin' glyph + 'Rua do Carmo 71, 1200-093 Lisbon, PT').

### Light full-bleed footer
A <footer> with a border-t border-ink-200 top hairline and a bg-white fill. Inner mx-auto flex max-w-7xl flex-col items-start justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-8 text-[13px] text-ink-500 (sm:flex-row sm:items-center lg:px-8). LEFT: a flex items-center gap-2 brand line = a grid h-6 w-6 place-items-center rounded-md bg-teal-700 text-white tile with a 'lucide:map-pinned' glyph, a font-semibold text-ink-700 'AtlasForms' wordmark, an ink-300 middot, and a '(c) 2026' note. RIGHT: a flex items-center gap-6 of three links 'Privacy' / 'Status' / 'Docs' (hover:text-ink-900). Below sm the footer goes flex-col items-start.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Map-beside-dark-form contact card: one overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-ink-200 bg-white shadow-card card split grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr], pairing a wide LEFT cartographic map/location panel with a narrow RIGHT dark ink-950 form rail; below lg it stacks to one column (the rail drops below the map) and the LEFT panel's divider flips from a right border (lg:border-r) to a bottom border (border-b).

### Componente
CSS-only cartographic map canvas: a .map-grid (background-color #e6f1ef + four layered linear-gradient grid lines, two fine rgba(15,118,110,.06) at 28px and two heavier rgba(15,118,110,.10) at 140px) overlaid with three organic .blob teal land masses (border-radius 42% 58% 55% 45% / 48% 50% 50% 52%, .07-.10 alpha) and five rounded white .road / .road-soft strips (border-radius 999px, rotated a few degrees) - a faux map drawn entirely in CSS, no real map tiles or brand imagery.

### Componente
Floating map pin + callout: a grid h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-white shadow-pop ring-1 ring-ink-200 PIN holding a small teal-700 dot ring-4 ring-teal-100, wired (ml-3) to a w-[244px] rounded-xl bg-white shadow-pop ring-1 ring-ink-200 CALLOUT CARD with a rotate-45 arrow nub, a 'Lisbon HQ' header, a teal mailto row (hover:bg-teal-50) and a muted phone row.

### Componente
'Where to find us' label pill: an absolute top-left inline-flex rounded-full bg-white/90 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold .tracky uppercase text-teal-800 shadow-card ring-1 ring-ink-200 pill led by a teal 'lucide:locate-fixed' glyph, floating over the map canvas.

### Componente
City strip with an active teal underline: a grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4 divide-x divide-ink-200 border-t row of four city cells (a font-bold name + a font-medium country), the first ACTIVE with an absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-0.5 bg-teal-700 top underline and teal country text.

### Componente
Dark inset .field controls with a teal focus ring: inputs/textarea on the dark rail with a 1px white/10 border + a white/[.04] fill + leading Lucide icons + ink-400 placeholders, that on :focus drop outline, turn the border teal-500 (#14b8a6), deepen the fill to ink-950 (#0b1220) and add box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(20,184,166,.18).

### Componente
Teal submit button with a rail glow: a .submit-btn w-full rounded-lg bg-teal-700 py-3 font-bold text-white 'Send message' button carrying a shadow-rail glow (0 24px 60px -24px rgba(15,94,89,.45)) and a leading 'lucide:send-horizontal' glyph, that lifts on hover (translateY(-1px) + 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(20,184,166,.6)).

### Componente
Sticky blurred light nav with animated underline links: a sticky top-0 z-50 border-b-ink-200/80 bg-paper/85 backdrop-blur-md bar with a teal 'lucide:map-pinned' logo tile + an 'Atlas' + teal 'Forms' wordmark, four .nav-link center links whose teal underline grows width 0 -> 100% on hover, a 'Sign in' link and a dark ink-900 'Get started' button.

### Componente
Inline dark contact card: a rounded-xl bg-white/[.04] p-4 ring-1 ring-white/10 card on the dark rail listing a mailto, a tel and an address row, each led by a teal-500 Lucide glyph (mail / phone / map-pin), with hover:text-teal-400 on the linked rows.

### Componente
Office-hours rows: two flex justify-between text-[13px] rows ('Mon - Fri' with a teal clock glyph + a white '9:00 - 18:00 WET' value, 'Sat - Sun' with a muted moon glyph + a 'Closed' value) under a .tracky uppercase 'Office hours' label.

## Notas Especiais
Keep the MAP-BESIDE-DARK-FORM contact system intact, it is the whole point: a calm LIGHT paper canvas (#f8fafc) + a slate ink text ramp + EXACTLY ONE accent, teal (#0f766e primary, with #0d9488 / #14b8a6 / #115e59 steps and #f0fdfa / #ccfbf1 tints), paired as a single rounded-2xl bordered white card split lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr] into a WIDE LEFT cartographic map/location panel and a NARROW RIGHT dark ink-950 form rail. Register the full Tailwind theme (paper #f8fafc; teal { 700 #0f766e, 800 #115e59, 600 #0d9488, 500 #14b8a6, 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1 }; ink { 950 #0b1220, 900 #0f172a, 800 #1e293b, 700 #334155, 600 #475569, 500 #64748b, 400 #94a3b8, 300 #cbd5e1, 200 #e2e8f0, 100 #f1f5f9 }) and the three box-shadows shadow-card '0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.12)', shadow-pop '0 12px 40px -8px rgba(15,23,42,.22)', shadow-rail '0 24px 60px -24px rgba(15,94,89,.45)'. Keep the dark form rail (bg-ink-950) with dark inset .field controls (1px white/10 border, white/[.04] fill, ink-400 placeholders, leading icons) and the teal focus signal (outline:none, border teal-500 #14b8a6, fill deepens to ink-950 #0b1220, box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(20,184,166,.18)), and the teal-700 .submit-btn with its shadow-rail glow + hover lift. Spend the single teal accent sparingly but consistently: the 'Contact' eyebrow pill, the logo tile + 'Forms' wordmark word, the map land/roads/pin, the active-city underline, the nav-link underline, the form focus ring, the 'Send message' button, the 'reply within a day' shield and the inline-contact-card icons. The signature texture is a CSS-ONLY cartographic map: a .map-grid (background-color #e6f1ef + four layered linear-gradient grid lines, two fine at rgba(15,118,110,.06) sized 28px 28px and two heavier at rgba(15,118,110,.10) sized 140px 140px) overlaid with absolutely-positioned .blob land masses (organic border-radius like 42% 58% 55% 45% / 48% 50% 50% 52%, teal at .07-.10 alpha) and rounded white .road / .road-soft strips (background #fff opacity .9 and rgba(255,255,255,.55), border-radius 999px, rotated a few degrees). Form fields are dark inset: a .field on a near-black rail with a 1px white/10 border and a white/[.04] fill, placeholder ink-400 (#94a3b8), that on :focus drops outline, turns the border teal-500 (#14b8a6), deepens the fill to ink-950 (#0b1220) and punches a teal ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(20,184,166,.18)). The submit button .submit-btn lifts on hover (translateY(-1px) + a teal glow 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(20,184,166,.6)). Nav links carry an animated teal underline (.nav-link::after grows from width 0 to 100% on hover, height 2px, bg #0f766e). Type is Inter only (Google Fonts, weights 400-900): the display headline is font-extrabold, tracking-tight, leading-[1.05] at text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl; eyebrows/labels use a .tracky uppercase wide letter-spacing of .14em; body and labels are font-medium/semibold in stepped ink opacities; the submit button and city names are font-bold. Corners are soft and modern (rounded-lg on fields/buttons/tiles, rounded-xl on the callout + inline contact card, rounded-2xl on the main card, rounded-full on the eyebrow + label pills). Mood: calm, trustworthy, modern, local and human, never a cold generic SaaS form.

layout_and_structure.description:
A full-bleed light contact page, centered inside a max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 (lg:px-8) container, stacked top to bottom as: (1) a sticky blurred light nav, (2) a full-bleed INTRO band (an eyebrow pill + display headline + lead), (3) THE CONTACT section, a single rounded-2xl bordered white card, and (4) a light full-bleed footer. The defining structural move is THE CONTACT CARD's asymmetric split: a grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr] card (overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-ink-200 bg-white shadow-card) pairing a LEFT map/location panel (much wider) with a RIGHT dark form rail (narrower). The LEFT panel is itself stacked: a tall .map-grid cartographic canvas (h-[360px] -> sm:h-[440px] -> lg:min-h-[560px] lg:flex-1) carrying floating overlays (a label pill top-left, a teal pin + white callout near center-left) above a 2/4-up city strip footer (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4, divide-x, the first city with a teal top underline). The RIGHT rail (bg-ink-950 p-7 sm:p-9) is stacked: a 'Connect' + social-tiles header row, the 'Get in contact' form (Email / Subject / Message + button + reassurance), and an 'Office hours' block (two day rows + an inline contact card). Everything reflows to a single column below lg (the form rail drops below the map panel, the LEFT panel switches from border-r to border-b); the nav center links hide below md, the 'Sign in' link hides below sm, the city strip goes 2-up below sm, the intro
hides below sm, the footer goes flex-col below sm; no horizontal overflow at 390px.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header with a border-b border-ink-200/80 bottom hairline and a translucent blurred paper fill (bg-paper/85 backdrop-blur-md). Inner row mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6 (lg:px-8). LEFT: a logo link (flex items-center gap-2.5) = a grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-teal-700 text-white shadow-card tile holding a Lucide 'lucide:map-pinned' glyph (text-[20px]), beside a text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark reading 'Atlas' in text-ink-900 + 'Forms' in text-teal-700. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex, gap-8): four nav links 'Product' / 'Templates' / 'Pricing' / 'Contact' in text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-600, each a .nav-link with an animated teal underline that grows from width 0 to 100% on hover (the current 'Contact' link set text-ink-900). RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Sign in' text link (hidden below sm, text-[14px] font-medium text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900) and a 'Get started' primary button (inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-ink-900 px-4 py-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-white shadow-card hover:bg-ink-800) with a trailing 'lucide:arrow-right' glyph (text-[15px]).

A full-bleed <section> with a border-b border-ink-200/70 bottom hairline on bg-paper. Inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-14 (lg:px-8 lg:py-20), holding a max-w-2xl block: first an EYEBROW PILL (inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-teal-700/20 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1 text-[12px] font-semibold .tracky uppercase text-teal-700) reading 'Contact', led by a Lucide 'lucide:message-square-dot' glyph (text-[14px]). Then a DISPLAY HEADLINE h1 (mt-5 text-4xl font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-ink-900 sm:text-5xl) reading 'Talk to a human,' + a hidden-on-mobile <br class='hidden sm:block'> + ' or find us on the map.' Then a mt-5 max-w-xl text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-ink-600 LEAD line: 'Send a note and a real person replies, usually within a few hours. Prefer to stop by? Pick an office below and we'll point you to the door.'

A <section id='contact'> on bg-paper. Inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-20 (lg:px-8) holding THE CARD: a grid grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white shadow-card lg:grid-cols-[1.65fr_1fr] container. The LEFT cell is a relative flex flex-col border-b border-ink-200 lg:border-b-0 lg:border-r (so below lg the divider is a bottom border, at lg it becomes a right border). The RIGHT cell is the dark form rail. The card clips its corners (overflow-hidden) so the map canvas and dark rail meet flush at the rounded edge.

Everything must reflow cleanly: the card stacks to one column below lg (the form rail drops below the map panel, the LEFT panel divider flips lg:border-r -> border-b), the city strip collapses sm:grid-cols-4 -> grid-cols-2 below sm, the nav center links hide below md, the 'Sign in' link hides below sm, the intro
hides below sm, the footer goes flex-col below sm, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, human and local with zero em-dashes ('Talk to a human, or find us on the map.', 'a real person replies', 'we'll point you to the door', 'Drop the details and we'll route you to the right person.', 'We reply within one business day.'). The map canvas must never load a real map provider, tile or logo, it is a calm decorative cartographic illustration drawn in CSS only.
